title: Claims Payments Rate Note: Parts-Delay Days on Partner Direct-Bill Invoice Payments under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
**Parts-delay share.** When a partner agency's direct-bill invoice is paid under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, the days the invoiced rental ran on extensions granted for a documented parts delay are billed at a reduced share. The parts-delay days are the days authorized on the rental's extensions whose recorded reason is *parts delay*.

| The rental | Latest estimate on the Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim written by | Share applied to parts-delay days |
|---|---|---|
| Carries parts-delay extension days | A Cardinal Select Shop | 0.85 (85%) of the day rate |
| Carries parts-delay extension days | A shop outside the Select network | 0.95 (95%) of the day rate |
| Carries no parts-delay extension | — | The full day rate |

## The parts-delay reduction

The parts-delay reduction is the parts-delay days multiplied by the day rate the invoice is paid at, multiplied by one less the share, rounded to the cent. The parts-delay days used here are no more than the days the invoice is paid for, which are its billable days. The reduction is taken off the agency payment for the invoice, which is the days the invoice is paid for multiplied by that day rate, before the payment is held to what the per-loss maximum still allows. The payment is never below zero and is rounded to the cent.

## Payment illustrations (hypothetical invoices, day rate $40.00)

| Days paid for | Parts-delay days | Shop | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 5 | Cardinal Select Shop | 5 multiplied by $40.00 multiplied by 0.15, which is $30.00 |
| 12 | 5 | Shop outside the Select network | 5 multiplied by $40.00 multiplied by 0.05, which is $10.00 |
| 6 | 10 | Cardinal Select Shop | 6 (no more than the days paid for) multiplied by $40.00 multiplied by 0.15, which is $36.00 |
| 12 | 0 | Either | None |

In the first line, the payment before the per-loss limit is 12 multiplied by $40.00, which is $480.00, less $30.00, which leaves $450.00.
